# Tinkercademy

> Singapore-based coders and makers teaching coding and digital making to schools, companies, and individuals. Courses in micro:bit, Swift, Python, and AI.

## Company and programmes

- [Home](https://tinkercademy.com/): Teaching areas and featured programmes.
- [About us](https://tinkercademy.com/about-us/): Company background and team.
- [All courses](https://tinkercademy.com/courses-all/): Programme catalogue with audience, domain, and platform filters.
- [Schools](https://tinkercademy.com/schools/): Programmes for schools.
- [Professionals](https://tinkercademy.com/professionals/): Training for companies and professionals.
- [Individuals](https://tinkercademy.com/individuals/): Learning opportunities for individuals.
- [Contact](https://tinkercademy.com/contact-us/): Programme enquiries and contact details.

## Projects and learning resources

- [Showcase](https://tinkercademy.com/showcase/): Projects and student work.
- [micro:bit](https://tinkercademy.com/microbit/): micro:bit resources and tutorials.
- [Build Log](https://tinkercademy.com/blog/): Stories about teaching, learning, and building.
- [Open source](https://tinkercademy.com/open-source/): Open-source projects.
